settings.title: Settings
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.admin_intro: Matomo is installed with this super user on the first save, so its web installer is never open to the network. The password is not stored by NS8.
settings.site_url_helper: Default: the Matomo host name. More websites can be added in Matomo.
settings.admin_user_invalid: Use letters, digits and . _ @ - (2 to 100 characters)
settings.ldap_enabled: Login with a user domain or LDAP server
settings.ldap_intro: Users log in to Matomo with their domain account (LoginLdap plugin). Local Matomo accounts, like the administrator, keep working.
settings.ldap_view_access: Access of a new domain user
settings.ldap_view_access_helper: Given on the first login. Super users can change it per user in Matomo.
settings.ldap_view_access_none: No access until granted in Matomo

ldap_login.no_domains: This cluster has no user domain yet. Add one in Domains and users, or enter an LDAP server.
ldap_login.group_helper: Only members of this group may log in (nested groups count). Empty: every user of the domain. Active Directory only.
ldap_login.group_custom_helper: Group name or DN; only its members may log in. Empty: every user found under the base DN. Active Directory only.
ldap_login.custom_intro: Only needed for a directory that is not a user domain of this cluster. NS8 can also add an external AD/LDAP as a user domain (Domains and users): then it shows up above and no credentials are stored here.
ldap_login.tls_verify_off: The certificate is not checked: someone in the network path could read the passwords. Only for tests or a trusted network.
ldap_login.bind_password_helper: Password of the service account; stored outside the module environment.
ldap_login.secret_is_set: A password is stored — leave blank to keep it.
ldap_login.ldap_domain_unknown: This user domain does not exist in the cluster
ldap_login.start_tls_with_ldaps: StartTLS is only for ldap:// URLs
ldap_login.ldap_group_requires_ad: A login group needs an Active Directory (memberOf)
